# The Holy Ghost Aum Vibration

### Sri Mrinalini Mata • Self-Realization Fellowship

Welcome and blessings. In the Christian scriptures, it is written: "In the beginning was the Word." Our beloved Guru explains that this sacred Word is the cosmic vibration of Aum, the Holy Spirit, which sustains all creation with divine light and energy.

### Hearing the Cosmic Sound

When we practice the scientific concentration techniques taught in the SRF Lessons, we can hear this beautiful inner sound. It may manifest as a distant ocean, a great hum, or sweet bells. By tuning our inner hearing to this vibration, we merge our restless mind into the vast, protective ocean of Peace.

### Bathing in the Holy Vibration

The cosmic sound of Aum is not just an auditory experience; it is a purifying, healing force. It floods our nervous system with cosmic energy and lifts our consciousness above all physical pain and mental anxiety.

### Practical Guidelines for Daily Life

* **Aum Technique:** Practice your meditation lessons daily to listen closely to the inner cosmic sounds.
* **Quiet the Mind:** Relax your body thoroughly before sitting for your silent practice.
* **Affirm Unity:** Feel that you are part of the vast, vibrating universe of His creation.
* **Respect Sacred Silence:** Keep a period of complete stillness after your meditation to absorb the peace.

Jai Guru! Jai Ma!
